questions.subject: physics
questions.content: A square loop PQRS having 10 turns, area and resistance is slowly and uniformly being pulled out of a uniform magnetic field of magnitude as shown. Work done in pulling the loop out of the field in is _________ .

en.content: A square loop PQRS having 10 turns, area and resistance is slowly and uniformly being pulled out of a uniform magnetic field of magnitude as shown. Work done in pulling the loop out of the field in is _________ .

hi.content: 10 फेरों, तल क्षेत्रफल , प्रतिरोध के एक वर्गाकार लूप , को के एकसमान चुम्बकीय क्षेत्र से धीरे-धीरे बाहर खींचा जाता है जैसा कि चित्र में दर्शाया गया है। इसे में क्षेत्र के बाहर खींचने में किया गया कार्य _______ है।
